houses.title: BG Modern Asymmetry House
houses.author: SimsWithNora
houses.style: Four stepped tiers on a lake lot: a teal-brick garage podium, a raised main floor reached up an exterior stair between stepped timber planters, three dark timber bays, an octagonal plunge pool on the podium roof, corner balconies with timber rails and two offset dark-timber penthouse boxes with copper ends, all under thin dark flat roofs

houses.title: Base Game Aurora
houses.author: Ornilia
houses.style: Layered white modern villa on a canal: picture-frame boxes with charcoal and taupe-board infill, a floating roof slab over two dark pavilions, a carport terrace, a front balcony and a pool forecourt

houses.title: Base Game House BG Family
houses.author: Turbogoku
houses.style: Stepped white-render and fieldstone cottage: a tall porch gable, a stone gable behind it, a low centre gable over the picture window and a small stone bay gable under a full-width dark side-gabled roof; black-framed windows, white fascia, two grey-render chimneys, a glazed side lounge under a glass gable, a wisteria porch, a picket-fenced hydrangea front and a lap pool behind a white privacy fence

houses.title: Base Game House
houses.author: olciaxxx_05
houses.style: Raised periwinkle lap-siding house over a dark-brick garage storey: a front-gabled wing under a shingled pent skirt on white pilasters, the pale glazed front door in the recess up a long brick stair with white balusters, stepped board-and-batten cross gables, a dormer and a red-brick chimney, Italian cypress, arborvitae and birch

houses.title: City One-Bedroom
houses.author: Companion Intelligence
houses.style: A mid-rise of pale render on a city street, five floors under a flat roof with a stair head, shops behind tall shopfront glass on the ground floor, a teal lobby door in the stair core, charcoal-framed windows and a steel-railed balcony band on every floor above; the one-bedroom apartment is the street-side bay of the first floor up, about 58 square metres for a couple who both work from home, with a short entry hall, an open living room and kitchen that open onto the street balcony, a desk nook by a west window, a bedroom and bathroom at the back and a laundry closet, its neighbours' flats closed beside it and behind it

houses.title: Cocoon Base Game
houses.author: Schnuck01
houses.style: Two-storey teal lap-siding colonial with taupe-brick garage and entry gables, a hipped roof with a big front cross gable and a nested bay gable, black louvred shutters and flower boxes, a low hipped east wing; warm taupe-and-cherry fireside interior; walled stone pool terrace

houses.title: Corner Penthouse
houses.author: Companion Intelligence
houses.style: A white-rendered penthouse pavilion with a deep flat roof overhang and floor-to-ceiling glass stands at the corner of a two-storey stone podium on a city street, a corner shop, a bike store, two flats and a stair lobby beneath it; the podium roof is a stone-floored terrace wrapping the pavilion behind glass rails, reached from the pavement by one long garden stair or by the private stair from the lobby, and the penthouse apartment inside is a long living room with a hearth, an island kitchen, a primary suite, two further bedrooms, an office and a book-lined nook

houses.title: Cute Basegame Starter
houses.author: TheClumsySimmer
houses.style: Slate-blue clapboard Cape Cod cottage: steep brown fish-scale side gable, two dormers, a red-brick gabled entry bay with an arched blue door, railed brick-floored porches either side, an end chimney and a lower bath wing

houses.title: Epiphany
houses.author: Schnuck01
houses.style: 1.5-storey oxblood-brick house under one steep bronze standing-seam roof that steps down west past a glass-roofed link to a low garage; a two-storey black-framed glazed slot notched into the front slope, a light-blue recessed entry bay with a black glazed pair, a gravel forecourt with a rock-edged sweep bed and cloud-pruned topiary

houses.title: Base Game Family Home
houses.author: TheClumsySimmer
houses.style: Two-storey sage-yellow lap-siding Victorian-farmhouse family home on a raised foundation: hipped roof with two overlapping street gables, a one-storey gabled west wing, a gabled entry portico and a picket-railed wrap veranda, slate-blue louvred shutters and flower boxes on every window, a warm cream wainscoted living room with a canted garden bay, and a backyard homestead (lily pond with a gazebo on a boardwalk, glass greenhouse, staggered raised beds, monkey bars)

houses.title: Base Game Family House
houses.author: SimsWithNora
houses.style: Mid-century raised ranch on a city park lot: a tuck-under garage between fieldstone piers under a balcony room with a dark slat rail, the main floor a storey up behind a brick-walled loggia, pale ashlar over a dark brick base under a tall west shed and a low asymmetric east gable, a switchback picket-railed stoop through brick planters, stepping stones across a lavender cottage garden

houses.title: Base Game Flowery Cottage
houses.author: MadamRedo
houses.style: Single-storey lakeside cottage: a cluster of blue-green board-and-batten cross-gables under olive shingle, a raised entry landing two steps over a sunken open living room, a flat meadow-roofed glass sunroom, a creek with a jetty and rowboat in a dense cottage garden

houses.title: Garden Flat
houses.author: Companion Intelligence
houses.style: A low two-storey block of vertical timber on a stone plinth under one long mono-pitch roof, with a charcoal stair core at its west end; the ground-floor apartment takes the east twelve metres, level from the street gate to every room, with a wide glazed living and dining room opening onto its own fenced garden terrace, a study on the front door's axis, two bedrooms and a bathroom with a level-access shower along a central passage, and a closed maisonette above

houses.title: Garden Nook (Base Game)
houses.author: HoldenRoark
houses.style: Single-storey powder-blue painted-brick cottage on a brick plinth: a clay-tile swoop skillion rising west to a white outrigger post meets a pale-gabled clay front gable in a V; string-lit porch of white column trios on a raised timber deck, recessed kitchen loggia, glass garden nook and a stucco chimney; gravel S-curve between curbed hydrangea and hibiscus beds, slatted rear pergola deck and a round flagstone hot-tub terrace

houses.title: Base Game Lake Cabin
houses.author: MadamRedo
houses.style: Craftsman lake house standing in the water: a greige gable block with a glazed prow, a long catslide over a set-back upper floor with a fieldstone breast and chimney, a slate-sided single-storey wing with a clerestory and a glass corner, a planted bank and a dark deck with a telescope over the pond

houses.title: Base Game Mediterranean
houses.author: TheClumsySimmer
houses.style: Symmetrical warm-white stucco villa: a two-storey centre with pavilion hips over canted bays and a recessed arched entry under an iron balcony, single-storey hipped wings, dark timber posts and geranium window boxes, a walled cypress forecourt with a tiered fountain, three rear arches onto a raised mosaic pool terrace with a pergola

houses.title: Villa Mesa Mariposa
houses.author: Schnucko
houses.style: Mid-century desert villa: split dark-tile shed roofs with thick rust fascias over caramel stucco, a glass-roofed conservatory dining room on the street corner, a vertical-timber tower, a recessed double-door entry under a slatted canopy, one-bay garage; a walled resort garden round a turtle-mosaic pool

houses.title: The Mirage
houses.author: Schnuck01
houses.style: Terraced hillside modern on a lake: a fieldstone plinth lifts the main floor, loggia and pool terrace a storey above a jungle bank and lily pond; a glass stair tower with stone piers, a bedroom floor cantilevered over the loggia on walnut fascias, a dark-timber clerestory, an olive lap-siding den and a pale stucco entry block

houses.title: Base Game Modern Home
houses.author: SimsWithNora
houses.style: Layered blue-and-white modern: a white-framed upper box with a recessed glass-railed loggia, a charcoal portal round the glazed stair, blue-grey concrete panels below, and a rear roof terrace with a plunge pool over the bedroom; a walnut-and-leather living room behind west glass onto a slatted pergola patio

houses.title: Base Game Modern House
houses.author: SimsWithNora
houses.style: Two near-equal modern volumes under opposed dark sheds: a one-storey walnut west wing falling west over a fin-framed recessed porch, and a two-storey blue-grey east block falling east with its upper storey set back behind a planted white band; walnut pilasters, a charcoal forecourt and a reflecting basin in front, a timber pool deck wrapping the back

houses.title: Base Game Modern House 1
houses.author: SimsWithNora
houses.style: Two-storey modern: a dark-timber flat-roofed box under a floating two-band lid, white and striped piers, a French entry on a tiled porch and a glazed bay with slat fins, stands forward of a white double-gable wing whose front gable is an open frame; gravel forecourt, a timber deck wrapped by a reflecting rill, a koi fountain by the drive

houses.title: Base Game Newcrest House
houses.author: xxSarina_27xx
houses.style: Tall narrow steep-gable lake-side townhouse-cottage: stucco, greige lap siding and a painted-brick strip under black trim, a garden floor beneath a raised front terrace, the main floor up an exterior stair, a steel-stair side deck, a loft in the gable

houses.title: The New Eco Base Game
houses.author: plnch25
houses.style: Two-storey eco-modern on a raised plinth: a projecting sage board tower between a one-storey glass living wing and a recessed double-door entry up broad dark timber steps, a cascade of rust-shingle roofs edged in thick chocolate fascia with glazed gable ends, a split-level garage with a loft dormer, tropical foundation beds and palms on a seaside lot

houses.title: Base Game One-Story House
houses.author: SimsWithNora
houses.style: One-storey cornflower-blue cottage: steep terracotta side gable, wide front cross gable, gabled dormers front and back, timber-clad gabled entry vestibule with a white arch, west brick chimney stack from grade, cottage foundation beds, rear L with a railed dining deck over an oval pool

houses.title: The Palms Base Game Fix
houses.author: Schnuck01
houses.style: Desert-modern city villa: blue-grey fieldstone and white render, a stone-and-glass west block showing its floating stair and grand piano through a timber spandrel band, a black-framed portal in the stone wall onto an open planted court, stepped brown standing-seam mono-pitches over black fascias, a resort back yard with terraced timber decks, an L-shaped pool, a spa gazebo and palms

houses.title: Paln Knoll of Ermosa
houses.author: Schnuck01
houses.style: White modern on a knoll: a three-band glazed tower between a lower entry block and a shed-roofed garage wing, thin charcoal slab roofs, two jogged flights of stone steps to a parapet-walled entry, a raised stone terrace and cascading pools in curved tropical beds

houses.title: Payorote (Base Game)
houses.author: plnch25
houses.style: Treehouse: dark-timber pods lodged in a giant lantern-hung host tree, a grey-blue clapboard French-door block beside a dark-brick pod with a bay, a ladder up from a wildflower meadow, a crow's nest, a roof terrace and a canopy pod above, a lake behind

houses.title: Riverbend Drive
houses.author: Schnuck01
houses.style: Two-storey two-tone brick family traditional on a riverside lot: one long side-gabled ridge with a single dormer, three wall gables across the front (brick over the garage, a tall brick centre gable, a whitewashed gable over a recessed glazed entry), a pent roof over the garage, a bay under its own hip, a lower hipped east wing with the hearth chimney; a rock-edged stream and topiary cones in front, a lily pond and willow on the west lawn, the river behind

houses.title: Base Game Seraphine
houses.author: Ornilia
houses.style: Queen Anne brick farmhouse: a cascade of front gables over a dark shingle roof with twin chimneys and dormers, white-columned front porch, book-lined open ground floor, lakeside pool garden

houses.title: Base Game Starter 18k 2/1
houses.author: Ornilia
houses.style: Single-storey cottage on a raised floor: a steep brown side gable with two brick dormers and a grey brick chimney, twin front-gabled glass wings (grey and red-brown brick) flanking a painted recessed entry in a black frame with a glazed French pair, open walnut living-dining-kitchen, one long whitewashed family bedroom with a kids' zone, a spindle-railed back porch and a privacy-fenced garden

houses.title: Warehouse Loft
houses.author: Companion Intelligence
houses.style: A converted brick warehouse on a city street, three storeys of red brick with soldier-course arches over tall steel-framed windows, a deep parapet and a stair core with its own street door; the loft apartment takes the west bay of the first two floors, one tall open room with a steel-railed sleeping platform on a ladder-stair, a kitchen run along the back wall and a workbench by the street door, with its neighbours' bays closed beside it and a steel balcony over the walled back court

houses.title: Base Game Sunny Home
houses.author: MadamRedo
houses.style: Modern barn cluster: a brick lounge gable and a taller charcoal curtain-wall gable, each glazed to the apex under a solid black roof, a set-back vertical-timber entry wing, a brick chimney, cypresses, a stone-edged gravel path, and a black-tile court with a round plunge pool below a dining deck

houses.title: Two-Bedroom Flat
houses.author: Companion Intelligence
houses.style: A three-storey walk-up tenement block on a city street, warm yellow stock brick with white sash windows under stone lintels, a pair of stacked canted bay windows, a stone stoop up to the stair core's oxblood street door and a slate hip roof with two dormers and a brick stack; the family's two-bedroom apartment is the whole first floor up, an entry hall and a passage that run back to a study alcove, a living room with a hearth and French doors onto an iron balcony over the street, a bay-windowed dining room, a closed kitchen with a terracotta floor, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a laundry along the back, with a ground-floor flat below and another flat above, both closed behind their blinds, and a walled brick court behind the block

houses.title: Valley-View Villa
houses.author: Axiisims
houses.style: Powder-blue riverside villa on a raised plinth: a set-back upper storey behind a full-width glass balcony, thin cream cantilevered slabs, a honey-timber pier portal, a curtained cabana on the water, an L-shaped glass-edged pool and a walled five-a-side pitch on a paved plaza

houses.title: Base Game Vanilla House
houses.author: MadamRedo
houses.style: Stepped five-part modern farmhouse in blue-white painted brick: glass-box greenhouse, tall front gable with a dark board panel, flat-roofed box, front-gabled living wing under a tan-brick chimney and a lattice-canopied east entry, behind a serpentine gravel walk, deep fern, lavender and hydrangea beds and a timber-edged lap pool

houses.title: Walk-up Duplex
houses.author: Companion Intelligence
houses.style: A four-storey dark brick block on a city street with white-railed access walkways across its face, a long flight of steps up to the first of them, a stair tower at one end and parking and stores on the ground floor; the family's duplex apartment takes the middle bay of the second and third floors, a kitchen and dining room opening onto a balcony over the back court, a living room with a desk against a brick wall, the family stair rising to three bedrooms, a bath and a study landing, with its neighbours' flats closed on either side and a flat roof above
